_comment: Prioritized work queue for the autonomous loop. Policy: security/bug first, then improvement/chore, then feature; within a tier lower P-number wins, ties FIFO by createdAt. Discovery agents append here. Selection is deterministic via scripts/ralph/lib/backlog.mjs (tested). Status: todo | in_progress | done | blocked.

items.title: Verify the full gate is green on the working branch and fix any red step
items.rationale: Invariant of the loop: never leave the gate red. First iteration establishes a green baseline before any feature work.
acceptance: pnpm qa runs to completion (lint + typecheck + 3 coverage suites + 9 audits)
Any failing step is fixed or its failure recorded as a new bug item

items.title: Confirm staging.yml & production.yml use drizzle-kit push (not db:migrate) and document in DEPLOY.md
items.rationale: memoria.md §8 decision (2026-06-24): SQL migration chain is structurally incomplete; db:push is the authority. Verify the workflows reflect this and the rationale is documented.
acceptance: Verify current state of .github/workflows/{staging,production}.yml against the db:push decision
If a workflow still calls db:migrate, switch it to db:push
docs/DEPLOY.md states why db:push is the authority

items.title: Deprecate route-paths.ts in favor of route-config.ts (verify overlap first)
items.rationale: memoria.md §8 lists route-paths.ts vs route-config.ts partial duplication. Verify it still exists (code wins over docs) before removing.
acceptance: Confirm the duplication still exists in the current code
If so, consolidate onto route-config.ts and remove route-paths.ts
Gate stays green; no dead imports (audit:dead-code)
